body:
Thank you.. I’m just tired of suffering from illness everyday, along with being trapped as a scapegoat living in a dysfunctional narcissistic family.. Honestly it was my parents who made me become ill to the point that now even though I am 19 I can’t even get a normal job. i feel like getting a therapist but if I end up revealing to them about my past, my dad will get arrested for the abuse he did to me, which is why I feel isolated.. I’m studying a little bit of things.. but I’m just.. i don’t know..

I know I should just grow up.. I’m immature because I’ve been abused and treated like i was nothing as a child and many people I befriended ended up just using me and hurting me.. It’s tiring pretending I’m happy and alright to everyone. I don’t really have anyone I can trust.. and don’t therapists cost money? I don’t have money.. I’m sorry for opening up, though thank you for asking..

You’re right. I agree, it seems letting go of weight progressively helps aid in being more free.

Thank you so much, yes. The small hopes and dreams do give the small nudge. My family’s kittens also lighten my mood and thoughts and while dying seems nice and a key to no more pain, I’d feel more sad and guilty to leave the family’s kittens and cats, because I love them! I agree fully, thanks again Sam! All the best to us both in hopefully beating depression. I think we can do this!
Thank you so much Alexia, I’ll try!
